# South Beacon

> An anonymised profile of a senior technology and security leader. Introductions through the talent agent.

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. The site is https://south-beacon.talent.sovereignweb.site/, static files in the public repository https://github.com/SovereignWebsite/Site__Talent__South-Beacon (served from site/ on the dev branch). Pick the section that matches who you are acting for, read it in full, then follow it.

## If you act for a visitor (read-only)

- Read the site's pages, starting at https://south-beacon.talent.sovereignweb.site/.
- Answer from what the site says, with a link for each point. When the site does not say something, say so plainly; never fill the gap with a guess.
- Do not change anything.

## If you act for the site's owner

- The owner changes the site through the repository. You need write access, which the owner gets by accepting the repository invitation: https://south-beacon.talent.sovereignweb.site/start/
- Work on the dev branch only; main is locked. Read the repository's CLAUDE.md first and follow it.
- Keep the site static: no server code, no cookies, no tracking. Never invent a fact, a price or a customer.
- Every push to dev publishes the site in a minute or two.
